title: 第1章 生似乡野稗草命如凿石见火第2章 天阶功法就在那
content_zh:

风卷着雨气拂过青瓦屋檐。
鱼吞舟蹲在檐下避雨，看那雨线绵延，打碎一个个浅浅的小水坑，涟漪模糊了其中映照的灰沉天空、黛色屋檐。
他扶了扶斗笠，抬头望去。
雨中小镇朦胧而模糊，远处高低错落的屋舍只剩水墨轮廓，连檐角的兽首都敛了往日的狰狞。
倒是远处的河埠头，隔着茫茫雨雾，还飘来几声摇橹声。
不疾不徐，慢得能把人的心性磨平。
眼看大雨一时半会小不了。
趁着闲来无事，鱼吞舟掏出几枚色泽温润，摩挲多年的铜钱，给自己起了一卦。
他静心凝神，默念要占卜之事，将三枚铜钱掷出，记下爻象，重复六次，最终得出了结果。
乾，初九。
望着卦象所示，少年紧绷眉眼舒展了几分。
乾卦为天，六爻皆阳，乃是六十四卦之首，大吉大利！
准不准另说，至少是个好兆头。
一卦算完，这场春雨也慢慢小了，果然是个好兆头。
鱼吞舟深吸一口气，凉意丝丝缕缕地沁到肺腑里，混杂着雨后的清冽与泥土的腥气，人也精神抖擞了几分。
他起身，双手合十，转身向着早已无人居住，废弃多年的老宅致谢鞠躬，算是感谢助他避雨，然后走下台阶，脚步轻慢。
爬满苔藓的青石板在雨天格外湿滑，鱼吞舟吃过亏，所以走的格外谨慎。
躲雨耽误了不少时间，所以他选择了抄近路，径直穿过几座同样破败的老宅。
每穿过一座老宅，鱼吞舟都会驻足致谢，对着空荡荡的堂屋方向，轻声一句叨扰了。

这是因为曾有人提点过他，他脚下的这座小镇，比较特殊，每一座破败老宅，都曾是某座显赫门庭视若命根子的“祖宅”
纵使如今人去楼空，沦为无人修缮的废弃老宅，但祖宅有灵，多多少少还是要心存敬意，不能胡来。
这番话鱼吞舟不仅听了进去，还牢记在了心里。
他特意去数过，小镇上一共有四十九户人家，而如今还住着人，或者说还有人留守的，只剩下三十九家。
剩余十户都沦为了无人问津的空宅。
“吞舟！
这边！”
远处河畔停靠着一艘渔船，身材不高大，却算得上壮实的汉子站在河埠石阶上，朝他招呼道。
汉子约莫三十来岁，皮肤是被风与烈日腌出来的古铜色，像浸透了桐油的老木，透着股风浪里打磨的糙劲儿。
他穿着件常年洗得发白的麻衣，赤着双脚，裤脚卷到膝盖，露出结实的小腿，筋肉虬结。
鱼吞舟快步迎上，目光扫过汉子身前满满的鱼筐，好奇道：
“老墨，今天的鱼获怎么比往日都要多的多？”
汉子姓墨，自称墨老六。
三年前鱼吞舟穿越到此方世界，误入此地后，老墨是他见到的第一个人。
这三年来鱼吞舟能在这座神秘而规矩繁多的小镇中活下来，也多靠老墨伸手帮衬。
老墨嘿然一声，抹了把脸上的雨水，道：
“小镇来人了，所以这鱼自然也得多抓些。
之前跟你提过的，三十年一次的风波要开始了，已经有人提前入场了。”
他又咂了咂嘴，道：
“你是没看见那阵仗，天女随行，仙乐缥缈，玉磬长鸣，排场大得吓人……不知道的，还以为是上古仙家出行，天降祥瑞之兆。

要不说是道家祖庭之一呢，就是气派。”

The wind carried the rain and blew over the eaves of the blue-tiled roof.
Yu Tunzhou squatted under the eaves to take shelter from the rain, watching the continuous rain lines, breaking the shallow puddles one after another, and the ripples blurring the gray sky and dark-colored eaves reflected in them.
He held up his bamboo hat and looked up.
In the rain, the town was hazy and blurry. Only the ink outlines of the scattered houses in the distance were left, and even the animal heads on the eaves and corners had lost their former ferocity.
On the other hand, from the river pier in the distance, through the vast rain and fog, there were still a few sounds of rowing.
Not fast, not slow, so slow that it can smooth people's minds.
It seems that the heavy rain will not let up for a while.
While he had nothing to do, Yu Tunzhou took out a few copper coins that had a warm color and had been rubbed for many years, and made a prediction for himself.
He calmly meditated on what he wanted to do for divination, threw out three copper coins, wrote down the lines, repeated six times, and finally got the result.
Qian, the ninth day of the lunar month.
Looking at the hexagram, the young man's tense eyebrows relaxed a bit.
The Qian hexagram is the sky, and the six lines are all Yang. It is the first of the sixty-four hexagrams, which means good luck and good fortune!
No matter what, it's at least a good sign.
After the calculation, the spring rain gradually subsided, which was indeed a good sign.
Yu Tunzhou took a deep breath, and the coolness filled his lungs. Mixed with the coolness after the rain and the smell of earth, he felt a little more energetic.
He stood up, clasped his hands, turned around and bowed to the old house that had been abandoned for many years, as a thank you for helping him avoid the rain, and then walked down the steps, walking slowly.
The moss-covered bluestones are extremely slippery on rainy days, and I have experienced losses in fish-swallowing boats, so I walk with extra caution.
Taking shelter from the rain wasted a lot of time, so he chose to take a shortcut and walked straight through several old houses that were also dilapidated.
Every time he passed through an old house, Yu Tunzhou would stop to express his thanks and whisper something in the direction of the empty main room.
This is because someone once mentioned to him that the town under his feet is quite special. Every dilapidated old house was once the "ancestral house" that a prominent family regarded as its lifeblood.
Even though the buildings are now deserted and reduced to an abandoned old house that no one has repaired, the ancestral house still has a spirit, and we still have to be more or less respectful and not act recklessly.
Yu Tunzhou not only listened to these words, but also remembered them in his heart.
He deliberately counted and found that there were a total of forty-nine households in the town, but now only thirty-nine households were still occupied by people, or in other words, there were still people staying.
The remaining ten households have been reduced to empty houses that no one cares about.
“Swallow the boat!
This way! "
There was a fishing boat docked on the river in the distance. A tall but sturdy man stood on the stone steps of the river port and greeted him.
The man was about thirty years old, and his skin was a bronze color pickled by the wind and scorching sun, like old wood soaked in tung oil, showing the roughness polished by the wind and waves.
He was wearing linen clothes that had been washed white all the time, his feet were bare, and his trousers were rolled up to his knees, revealing his strong calves with knotted muscles.
Yu Tunzhou hurried up to meet him, glanced at the full fish basket in front of the man, and said curiously:
"Old Mo, why are there so many more fish caught today than in the past?"
The man's surname was Mo and he called himself Mo Laoliu.
Three years ago, Yu Tunzhou traveled to this world. After entering this place by mistake, Lao Mo was the first person he saw.
In the past three years, Yu Tunzhou has been able to survive in this mysterious town with many rules, mainly because of Lao Mo's help.
Old Mo exclaimed, wiped the rain off his face and said:
“There are people coming to the town, so naturally we have to catch more fish.
As I mentioned to you before, the storm that happens once in thirty years is about to begin, and some people have already entered the market in advance. "
He smacked his lips again and said:
"Didn't you see the battle, with the goddesses accompanying them, the fairy music ethereal, the jade chimes sounding, the pomp and circumstance so frightening... If you don't know, you thought it was an auspicious sign from the heavens for the ancient immortal family traveling.
If not to say it is one of the ancestral houses of Taoism, it is majestic. "
